sources.title: Clownstein/Black-Onyx-12B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Black Onyx 12B Black Onyx 12B is a cybersecurity-specialized fine-tune of Google Gemma 4 12B Instruction-Tuned. The model was trained through a multi-stage pipeline combining continued cybersecurity training, supervised fine-tuning, GRPO, and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
